text:
priya_support: Customer reported our streaming SSE responses getting cut off and leaving invalid/malformed JSON. They call it "fragment loss" — final array/closing brace never arrives when requests flow through an edge proxy.

jason_eng_runtime: can you paste the raw response capture + headers?

priya_support: pasted below. They hit /v1/generate?stream=true through a managed edge that does TLS termination and HTTP/2->HTTP/1.1 muxing. The client sees the stream stop after the last data event; no trailing finish event.

priya_support: ```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Cache-Control: no-cache

data: {"id":"gen_abc","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"partial"}}]}
data: {"id":"gen_abc","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"more"}}]}
data: {"id":"gen_abc","choices":[{"delta":{"content":""},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}

<socket closed by edge — client never sees final wrapper/closing brace>
```

maria_net: quick questions: does the edge have an idle socket timeout or a max-chunk-window? many CDNs kill long-lived chunked responses (~15-30s) unless keepalives are sent.

priya_support: customer says proxy idle timeout is ~20s. they also have an optimization hop that rewrites some headers.

jason_eng_runtime: hypothesis: our final serialized wrapper (we emit a final SSE event with the closing JSON structure) is still buffered or waiting on kernel flush; proxy kills the TCP connection before that event is flushed. result: client gets a truncated JSON document and fails parsing. reproduced locally by force-closing the socket mid-stream.

jason_eng_runtime: repro I ran: `curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?stream=true` then simulate the proxy kill with `nc` closing the connection — JSON stops mid-structure and client parser errors.

priya_support: customer wants mitigation suggestions and a short-term workaround.

jason_eng_runtime: recommended mitigations:
- Switch to non-streaming mode (stream=false) for guaranteed complete JSON when latency isn't critical.
- Increase edge/proxy idle timeout or configure it to not buffer SSE boundaries (pass through as raw chunks).
- Client-side tolerant parser: attempt to salvage trailing fragments or retry with a range / resume request when partial JSON is detected.
- Server-side: send periodic SSE comment keepalives (`: keepalive`) to keep the connection active across proxies.

maria_net: also check muxers that translate HTTP/2 -> HTTP/1.1; they sometimes coalesce chunked frames and drop final fragments on abrupt upstream close. tcpdump showing FIN/RST from the proxy will confirm.

priya_support: I'll send these to the customer and ask for tcpdump + edge config. I'll also create an internal ticket to add an optional SSE heartbeat for customers behind aggressive proxies.

ops-bot: Ticket INC-4821 created: "sse-heartbeat-option for streaming endpoints" (priority: P2).

jason_eng_runtime: I'll prototype a heartbeat that emits `: keepalive` every 5s and a config flag to enable per-tenant. That should keep most proxies from idling out.

priya_support: can you also provide a minimal curl sample we can give the customer to reproduce?

jason_eng_runtime: ```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Cache-Control: no-cache" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=xlarge&stream=true&structured_output=true"
```

priya_support: thanks — forwarding now. will escalate if they still see truncated JSON. :pray:
